summary: The Bank of Nova Scotia filed a Form 6-K containing its third quarter 2026 earnings release. The filing reports record quarterly net income of CAD 2,953 million, diluted EPS of CAD 2.27, and a CET1 capital ratio of 13.1%, with highlights by business segment. This is a routine earnings announcement by a foreign private issuer, not a special-situation corporate event. No transaction, activist activity, tender offer, or structural change is described. The filing is purely informational and satisfies SEC reporting obligations.
